detailed_description: The JSON to Form Generator turns a pasted top-level JSON object into a simple browser-side form preview and generated code. It infers field types from values, such as number, checkbox, email, date, textarea, select for arrays, or text, marks non-empty values as required, and can generate either basic HTML form markup or a React component snippet. You can load an example, generate fields, preview the form, choose HTML or React output, and copy the generated code. It does not import JSON files, read JSON Schema constraints, support Vue output, handle nested form hierarchies, or provide conditional logic and advanced validation editors.
usage_steps: Paste a top-level JSON object into the textarea or click Load Example.
Click Generate to parse the JSON and infer simple form fields.
Review the generated form preview and any invalid JSON or non-object error.
Choose HTML or React output from the format dropdown.
Copy the generated code when the preview looks useful.
usage_examples: Create a quick form preview from a flat user profile JSON object.
Generate basic HTML inputs from sample strings, numbers, booleans, and arrays.
Copy a React component snippet for a simple prototype form.
Use the example JSON to see how emails, dates, long text, and arrays are inferred.
